title: Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
body:
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoti hai kaisi ghurbat, kaise kahe wo maa se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Zindaa'n ke andhero'n me, dum ghut'ta hai ab mera
amma bohot hai wehshat, ghar le chalo yahaa'n se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Zaalim ki aziyyat se, hai kaan mere zaqmi
aye ammu bacha leeje, is shimre bad eemaa'n se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Zindaa'n ke dar pa aakar, ye puchti thi aksar
kab jaaenge watan ko, aye bhai hum yahaa'n se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Kaise bayaa'n karu mai, jo mujh pe guzarti hai
baba hai na hai ammu, chudhwaae jo zindaa'n se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Baazaar-e-shaam me thi, Abid pa ye musibat
sab bibiyo'n ke shaane , baandhe the reesmaa se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Nanha sa ek gala tha, rassi me jo bandha tha
Khul waao is rasan ko, kehti thi naatawaa'n se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
7) loota hua wo saamaa'n , waapas mila hai jis dam
nanhi si ek rida ko, hasrat se dekha maa ne
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Maa kis tarah bhulaayei'n, masooma ki sadaayei'n
Pardes me na koi, bacchi juda ho maa se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Hyder bapa tha mehshar , aaya jo shaah ka sar
godi me liye sar ko, ruqsat hui wo maa se
<<MINI>>
Kya cheez yatimi hai poocho ye sakina se
